claims.claim: Air Pump-requires minimum effort and within a few strokes air gets inflated
claims.evidence: Witness photos show an electric handheld soldering/heat tool with a cord and metal tip/nozzles; no air pump or inflation mechanism is shown.
Witness photos do not provide a weight/scale or clear construction details to confirm the item is lightweight.

risks.risk: Item may not be an air pump; seller description conflicts with what the witness identified (electric soldering/heat tool). This can lead to buying the wrong category of goods.
risks.proof: Ask for a short video showing the exact item being used for air inflation (or show the pump body/valve). Also ask for a clear shot of the front end and any pump nozzle/valve.
risks.if_unproven: Price as a used electric soldering/heat tool (worst case: untested/unknown working condition).

risks.risk: Heating performance is unknown (may not reach temperature, may be faulty heater).
risks.proof: Video/clip of the tool powering on and heating: show the tip warming up within a short time and stable operation (no flicker/smoke).
risks.if_unproven: Price as not working or unverified working (worst case: treat as for parts/repair).

risks.risk: Tip/nozzle condition is unknown (wear, corrosion, bent tip, poor contact).
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the metal tip(s) from multiple angles plus a clip showing the tip seated firmly (no wobble).
risks.if_unproven: Price as worn/possibly needing replacement tips.

risks.risk: Cord and plug/connector integrity is unknown end-to-end (possible internal break, loose connector).
risks.proof: Photo of the entire cord length (including strain relief) and a clip showing the plug/connector seated securely with no power cut during gentle movement.
risks.if_unproven: Price as cord/connection unverified (worst case: electrical fault risk).

risks.risk: Accessories and required parts may be missing (stand, solder wire, spare tips, desoldering tools).
risks.proof: Inventory photo/clip laid out: show every included accessory and any spare tips/parts.
risks.if_unproven: Price as tool-only with no extras.

proof_requests: Send a clear photo of the full item (front, back, and any label/ratings plate) to confirm the exact model and voltage/plug type.
Send a short video proving it heats up properly (power on → tip warms within seconds → stable operation).
Send close-ups of the tip/nozzles showing wear/corrosion and whether they are straight and firmly attached.
Send photos of the entire cord end-to-end and the plug/connector; include a clip where the cord is gently moved while powered to confirm no cut-outs.
Show all included accessories/spare tips (if any) in one laid-out shot.
response.reason: The witness identifies an electric soldering/heat tool, while the seller claims it is an air pump; heating and electrical functionality are unverified. Without proof of the correct item and working status, a reliable worst-case price cannot be set confidently.
